views.name: h1_noamb
views.eval: const g=__game; g._qaAmb=g.ambience.update; g.ambience.update=()=>{}; window.__r=__qa.matchSim(120); g.ambience.update=g._qaAmb;

views.name: h2_full_logged
views.eval: const g=__game; let i=0; const t0=performance.now(); __qa.sim(120, 1/30, ()=>{ if(i%30===0) console.warn('QA step '+i+' t='+g.time.toFixed(1)+' alive='+g.bots.filter(b=>b.alive).length+' ms='+(performance.now()-t0).toFixed(0)); i++; }); window.__r2={steps:i};
